newsitem.title: USA: Data Broadcasting to buy news unit.
newsitem.headline: Data Broadcasting to buy news unit.

text.p: Data Broadcasting Corp said on Friday it agreed to buy Federal News Service Group Inc, which provides verbatim transcripts of U.S. and Russian goverment hearings and news conferences to the media.
The real-time market data company said in a statement it agreed to acquire substantially all of Federal News Service's assets for about $7 million in common stock and options.
Federal News, an international news and corporate information provider headquartered in Washington D.C., had revenues of $4.2 million for the year ended June 30.

To buy the assets, Data Broadcasting said it would issue common stock and options and would assume specific liabilities. It said it would pay additional common stock depending on Federal's earnings growth during the 12 months after the deal closed.
The deal was expected to have a positive impact on Data's earnings, it said.
It was subject to the execution of a definitive purchase agreement and was expected to close within 30 to 60 days, the company said.
